comments.body: Reproduced on staging with a fresh workspace. Attaching the request id.

content.text: Reproduced on staging with a fresh workspace. Attaching the request id.
Steps to reproduce: open duplicate notification emails with a workspace that has more than one member.
Expected: the view keeps the selected filters after a reload.
Actual: filters reset to the default and the row count changes.
Impact: reported by two customers this week; no data loss observed.
